note: SKYLINE entries hold a webcam PAGE url and resolve to a manifest at play time, because Skyline's manifest URLs carry a token regenerated on every request. That is what makes them durable where hardcoded lists rot. Browse skylinewebcams.com, copy any cam's page URL, and add it via Live Feed > Add a stream.
